spec2def(ntprint.dll ntprint.spec)

# ntprint.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ntprint-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(ntprint_shims OBJECT ntprint.c)
target_link_libraries(ntprint_shims PRIVATE wine libwinspool libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(ntprint_shims)
add_cargo_module(ntprint ntprint-cargo ntprint.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ntprint_shims psdk)
